data: Hanoch est seul sur une plage déserte d’un petit village des Landes. Au loin, Israël, son pays, qu’il a quitté pour une raison mystérieuse. Quelques jours plus tard, une jeune femme le retrouve inconscient sur le rivage. Personne ne parvient à savoir qui il est. L’inspecteur Ruben Vardi est sur le point de prendre sa retraite : pas question de se charger de cette affaire. Mais des faits étranges le décident à changer d’avis… (Hanoch is alone on the deserted beach of a small village in the Lances, far from Israel, his homeland, which he left for mysterious reasons. A few days later, a young woman finds him unconscious on the shore. No one can work out who he is. Inspector Ruben Vardi is about to retire: it's out of the question that he should take charge of this case. But strange events make him change his mind.)

Hanoch is alone on the deserted beach of a small village in the Lances, far from Israel, his homeland, which he left for mysterious reasons. A few days later, a young woman finds him unconscious on the shore. No one can work out who he is. Inspector Ruben Vardi is about to retire: it's out of the question that he should take charge of this case. But strange events make him change his mind.
